name: side
title: Body side plate
orientation: Flat on the bed: the hips' faces down
description: Two hip hubs joined by a spar, with the windows the hip motors go through and four pilot holes for the cross beams. The two sides are the same print, turned end for end.

half.rule: Hip to the middle: the body's half-length

thick.rule: The plate: enough for the housing's three M3 screws to bite

hub.rule: A hub's radius: past the housing's feet

spar.rule: The spar's depth between the hubs

window.rule: The motor's way through the plate: a NEMA 17 and 1.1 mm each side

corner.rule: Round the corners of the window

beam_at.rule: The two cross beams, between the hip motors: the motors take the space from 54 mm to the plate's end

beam_y.rule: Each beam's two screws, this far either side of its middle
